case_type: ESG process representation versus actual implementation
claim_text: ESG risks, opportunities and issues were considered throughout the research process via proprietary quality reviews.
claim_source: Overlay Fund prospectuses and RFP responses summarized in SEC order
evidence_summary: The SEC order states that numerous investments lacked an ESG quality-review score. In one fund, 67 of 185 investments lacked a score at the relevant time, representing nearly 25% of net assets. The order found that a reasonable investor could mistakenly infer that all holdings were reviewed.
expected_reasoning: Separate policy language from evidence of implementation.
Use fund-level counts and net-asset share as quantitative evidence.
Do not equate the existence of an ESG team with universal review coverage.
Preserve the settlement qualifier: no admission or denial.
legal_caution: The order concerns specified funds, statements and period, not all BNY products.
